summary.text: Carla Danielson is the Republican and Conservative Party nominee challenging incumbent Marcela Mitaynes for NY State Assembly District 51. She advanced to the general election without a contested primary. Ballotpedia lists no prior campaigns, and no campaign website, survey response or news coverage was found.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists her as the Republican and Conservative Party candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election; the Republican and Conservative primaries were canceled and she appears on the ballot without a primary contest. No further biographical details were available from the sources reviewed.
